title: Weather Forging
description:
Cinematic, system-agnostic weather for Foundry VTT. Snow that settles on your maps, rain that soaks the ground, fog that drifts with the wind and thunderstorms that light up the whole scene.

  • Living maps: accumulating snow with drifts, wet ground with puddles and ripples, snowy roofs and tiles.
  • Atmosphere: rain, snow, hail and ash driven by wind, drifting fog, moving cloud shadows.
  • Real lighting: clouds darken the scene through Foundry's lighting, lightning lights it up for every player at once.
  • Weather-reactive interface: frost, cold and storm tints across the whole UI.
  • Easy control: GM panel with smooth transitions, weather editor with custom presets, a widget for players.
  • No-weather zones: Regions with the Suppress Weather behavior, roofs keep interiors dry.
  • For developers: a weather state other systems and modules can read and drive.
